intent: Make CI run the predeployment contract gate for every main-branch change that is explicitly ready for deployment, not only version-release commits.

requestReview.reason: This changes only GitHub Actions gate selection and cannot alter application, Firebase, WebRTC, update, or device request traffic.

rollback: Revert the CI workflow commit; application binaries, Hosting content, and registered data remain unchanged.

outcomes.acceptance: A main-branch push whose contract is ready-to-deploy with deploy impact runs the predeployment gate, while ordinary and proof-only pushes continue to require the completed verified contract.
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-05: `npx vitest run src/desktopPackaging.test.ts -t "builds releases from gated main commits so release caches remain reusable"` passed 1/1. The contract pins main-push stage selection to `ready-to-deploy` plus `deploy` or `build-and-deploy`, while release creation remains restricted to `Prepare WonRemote v...` commits.
